{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01H94WWiLg6tozbDyqaudZCj","type":"tool_result","content":"tests/conftest.py\ntests/test_boundaries.py\ntests/test_cli.py\ntests/test_config.py\ntests/test_currencies.py\ntests/test_ecb.py\ntests/test_fetch.py\ntests/test_foundation.py\ntests/test_health.py\ntests/test_help.py\ntests/test_init.py\ntests/test_launcher.py\ntests/test_load.py\ntests/test_load_visibility.py\ntests/test_rates_by_date.py\ntests/test_rates_latest.py\ntests/test_serve.py\ntests/test_stats.py\ntests/test_usage.py\ntests/test_web.py\n---\n\"\"\"FastAPI application factory and the module-level app for `uvicorn app_server.main:app`.\"\"\"\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI\n\nfrom app_server import routes\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    \"\"\"Build a new FastAPI application that includes the shared router.\"\"\"\n    application = FastAPI()\n    application.include_router(routes.router)\n    return application\n\n\napp = create_app()\n\"\"\"Shared router registry. Feature stories attach their routes here; static routes go first.\"\"\"\n\nimport datetime\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Path\n\nfrom fxrates_app import currencies as currency_service\nfrom fxrates_app import rates as rate_service\nfrom fxrates_app import stats as stats_service\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\nDATE_PATTERN = r\"^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$\"\n\n\n@router.get(\"/health\")\ndef health() -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Liveness probe. It reaches no store, so it answers even when the database is absent.\"\"\"\n    return {\"status\": \"ok\"}\n\n\n@router.get(\"/stats\")\ndef stats() -> dict[str, int | str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Counts of stored dates and rates, and the first and last publication dates.\"\"\"\n    return stats_service.stats()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/currencies\")\ndef currencies() -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"The base currency and every stored currency code, ascending.\"\"\"\n    return {\"base\": rate_service.BASE, \"currencies\": currency_service.currencies()}\n\n\n@router.get(\"/rates/latest\")\ndef rates_latest() -> dict[str, str | dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"The rates of the latest publication, with requested \"latest\"; 404 when nothing is stored.\"\"\"\n    found = rate_service.latest_rates()\n    if found is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"no publication is stored\")\n    effective, rates = found\n    return {\"date\": effective, \"requested\": \"latest\", \"base\": rate_service.BASE, \"rates\": rates}\n\n\n@router.get(\"/rates/{date}\")\ndef rates_on_date(date: Annotated[str, Path(pattern=DATE_PATTERN)]) -> dict[str, str | dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"The rates of the latest publication on or before `date`; 422 for an impossible date, 404 when none exists.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        requested = datetime.date.fromisoformat(date).isoformat()\n    except ValueError as error:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f\"not a real calendar date: {date}\") from error\n    found = rate_service.rates_on(requested)\n    if found is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f\"no publication on or before {requested}\")\n    effective, rates = found\n    return {\"date\": effective, \"requested\": requested, \"base\": rate_service.BASE, \"rates\": rates}\n\"\"\"In-process test client for the application; used by acceptance and the pytest suite.\"\"\"\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app_server.main import create_app\n\n\ndef web_client() -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"Return a TestClient wrapping a new application instance.\"\"\"\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\"\"\"HTTP application package: the FastAPI factory, the shared router registry, and the test client.\"\"\"\n---\n\"\"\"Rates on a calendar day: the effective publication date and the rates published on it.\n\nThe ECB publishes on working days only, so a request for any date resolves to the latest\npublication on or before it. Rates are returned as the stored text, never converted to a float.\nReads go through `db.rates` only.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom persistence import Database\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\nBASE = \"EUR\"\n\n\ndef _effective(db: Database, day: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the latest stored publication date on or before `day`, or None when none exists.\"\"\"\n    rows = db.rates.list_on_or_before(as_of=day)\n    return rows[0].date if rows else None\n\n\ndef effective_date(d: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the latest publication date on or before `d`, or None when no such date exists.\"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        return _effective(db, d)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n\n\ndef _rates_of(db: Database, effective: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Return {currency: stored rate text} for the publication on `effective`, base excluded.\"\"\"\n    rows = db.rates.list_for_date(date=effective)\n    return {row.currency: row.rate for row in rows if row.currency != BASE}\n\n\ndef rates_on(requested: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return (effective date, {currency: stored rate text}) for `requested`, or None.\n\n    None means no publication exists on or before `requested`. The base currency never appears in\n    the mapping.\n    \"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        effective = _effective(db, requested)\n        if effective is None:\n            return None\n        rates = _rates_of(db, effective)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return effective, rates\n\n\ndef latest_rates() -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return (latest publication date, {currency: stored rate text}), or None when nothing is stored.\n\n    The latest date is the first row of `list_on_or_before` called without a bound.\n    \"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        rows = db.rates.list_on_or_before()\n        if not rows:\n            return None\n        effective = rows[0].date\n        rates = _rates_of(db, effective)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return effective, rates\n\"\"\"FxRates application package.\n\nApplication modules (config, ecb, fetch, rates, history, convert, commands) are added by later\nbuild blocks. Database access goes through the shipped `persistence` package only.\n\"\"\"\n---\n\"\"\"Summary of the store: how many dates and rates it holds, and its first and last publication dates.\n\nEvery value is derived from `db.rates.list_all_keys`; the service counts and takes the extremes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\n\ndef stats() -> dict[str, int | str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Return the dates and rates counts and the first and last dates, None when nothing is stored.\"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        keys = db.rates.list_all_keys()\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    dates = sorted({key.date for key in keys})\n    return {\n        \"dates\": len(dates),\n        \"rates\": len(keys),\n        \"first\": dates[0] if dates else None,\n        \"last\": dates[-1] if dates else None,\n    }\n---\n#!/bin/sh\n# CommandCenter Operation\n# Name: Run Test Suite\n# Type: batch\n\n# --- Standard Preamble ---\nset -eu\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")\" && pwd)\"\nPROJECT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)\"\nLOG_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/data/logs\"\nmkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\n\nTIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S')\nSCRIPT_NAME=$(basename \"$0\" .sh)\nLOG_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/${SCRIPT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.log\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME started at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ===\" | tee \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Arguments: $*\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Working dir: $PROJECT_DIR\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"---\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\n\ncd \"$PROJECT_DIR\"\n\nif [ ! -f \".venv/bin/activate\" ]; then\n    echo \"Environment missing: run 'uv sync' in $PROJECT_DIR first\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# --- Run the declared test_command: pytest -q ---\n# Calls the environment's pytest directly; sourcing activate trips `set -u`. Output is captured\n# in full so the exit status of pytest is kept (a pipe would hide it).\nset +e\n\"$PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/pytest\" -q >\"$LOG_FILE.pytest\" 2>&1\nSTATUS=$?\nset -e\ncat \"$LOG_FILE.pytest\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\nrm -f \"$LOG_FILE.pytest\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME finished at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') with status $STATUS ===\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\nexit \"$STATUS\"\n---\nf97a219 Build block-12: FEATURE-RatesLatest.md, FEATURE-LoadVisibility.md [built]\n7d71fb8 Build block-11: FEATURE-Stats.md, FEATURE-Currencies.md, FEATURE-RatesByDate.md, FEATURE-CommandHelp.md [built]\nb06db84 Build block-10: FEATURE-ServeHealth.md [built]","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"02287bb7-5dee-4304-8fa2-e6c3b7822ad6","uuid":"2b8b163e-d545-4586-b2e3-18cdac2066fa","timestamp":"2026-10-27T16:39:54.926Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"tests/conftest.py\ntests/test_boundaries.py\ntests/test_cli.py\ntests/test_config.py\ntests/test_currencies.py\ntests/test_ecb.py\ntests/test_fetch.py\ntests/test_foundation.py\ntests/test_health.py\ntests/test_help.py\ntests/test_init.py\ntests/test_launcher.py\ntests/test_load.py\ntests/test_load_visibility.py\ntests/test_rates_by_date.py\ntests/test_rates_latest.py\ntests/test_serve.py\ntests/test_stats.py\ntests/test_usage.py\ntests/test_web.py\n---\n\"\"\"FastAPI application factory and the module-level app for `uvicorn app_server.main:app`.\"\"\"\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI\n\nfrom app_server import routes\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    \"\"\"Build a new FastAPI application that includes the shared router.\"\"\"\n    application = FastAPI()\n    application.include_router(routes.router)\n    return application\n\n\napp = create_app()\n\"\"\"Shared router registry. 422 for an impossible date, 404 when none exists.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        requested = datetime.date.fromisoformat(date).isoformat()\n    except ValueError as error:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f\"not a real calendar date: {date}\") from error\n    found = rate_service.rates_on(requested)\n    if found is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f\"no publication on or before {requested}\")\n    effective, rates = found\n    return {\"date\": effective, \"requested\": requested, \"base\": rate_service.BASE, \"rates\": rates}\n\"\"\"In-process test client for the application; used by acceptance and the pytest suite.\"\"\"\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app_server.main import create_app\n\n\ndef web_client() -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"Return a TestClient wrapping a new application instance.\"\"\"\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\"\"\"HTTP application package: the FastAPI factory, the shared router registry, and the test client.\"\"\"\n---\n\"\"\"Rates on a calendar day: the effective publication date and the rates published on it.\n\nThe ECB publishes on working days only, so a request for any date resolves to the latest\npublication on or before it. Rates are returned as the stored text, never converted to a float.\nReads go through `db.rates` only.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom persistence import Database\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\nBASE = \"EUR\"\n\n\ndef _effective(db: Database, day: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the latest stored publication date on or before `day`, or None when none exists.\"\"\"\n    rows = db.rates.list_on_or_before(as_of=day)\n    return rows[0].date if rows else None\n\n\ndef effective_date(d: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the latest publication date on or before `d`, or None when no such date exists.\"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        return _effective(db, d)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n\n\ndef _rates_of(db: Database, effective: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Return {currency: stored rate text} for the publication on `effective`, base excluded.\"\"\"\n    rows = db.rates.list_for_date(date=effective)\n    return {row.currency: row.rate for row in rows if row.currency != BASE}\n\n\ndef rates_on(requested: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return (effective date, {currency: stored rate text}) for `requested`, or None.\n\n    None means no publication exists on or before `requested`. The base currency never appears in\n    the mapping.\n    \"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        effective = _effective(db, requested)\n        if effective is None:\n            return None\n        rates = _rates_of(db, effective)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return effective, rates\n\n\ndef latest_rates() -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return (latest publication date, {currency: stored rate text}), or None when nothing is stored.\n\n    The latest date is the first row of `list_on_or_before` called without a bound.\n    \"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        rows = db.rates.list_on_or_before()\n        if not rows:\n            return None\n        effective = rows[0].date\n        rates = _rates_of(db, effective)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return effective, rates\n\"\"\"FxRates application package.\n\nApplication modules (config, ecb, fetch, rates, history, convert, commands) are added by later\nbuild blocks. Database access goes through the shipped `persistence` package only.\n\"\"\"\n---\n\"\"\"Summary of the store: how many dates and rates it holds, and its first and last publication dates.\n\nEvery value is derived from `db.rates.list_all_keys`; the service counts and takes the extremes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\n\ndef stats() -> dict[str, int | str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Return the dates and rates counts and the first and last dates, None when nothing is stored.\"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        keys = db.rates.list_all_keys()\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    dates = sorted({key.date for key in keys})\n    return {\n        \"dates\": len(dates),\n        \"rates\": len(keys),\n        \"first\": dates[0] if dates else None,\n        \"last\": dates[-1] if dates else None,\n    }\n---\n#!/bin/sh\n# CommandCenter Operation\n# Name: Run Test Suite\n# Type: batch\n\n# --- Standard Preamble ---\nset -eu\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")\" && pwd)\"\nPROJECT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)\"\nLOG_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/data/logs\"\nmkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\n\nTIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S')\nSCRIPT_NAME=$(basename \"$0\" .sh)\nLOG_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/${SCRIPT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.log\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME started at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ===\" | tee \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Arguments: $*\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Working dir: $PROJECT_DIR\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"---\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\n\ncd \"$PROJECT_DIR\"\n\nif [ ! -f \".venv/bin/activate\" ]; then\n    echo \"Environment missing: run 'uv sync' in $PROJECT_DIR first\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# --- Run the declared test_command: pytest -q ---\n# Calls the environment's pytest directly; sourcing activate trips `set -u`. Output is captured\n# in full so the exit status of pytest is kept (a pipe would hide it).\nset +e\n\"$PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/pytest\" -q >\"$LOG_FILE.pytest\" 2>&1\nSTATUS=$?\nset -e\ncat \"$LOG_FILE.pytest\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\nrm -f \"$LOG_FILE.pytest\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME finished at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') with status $STATUS ===\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\nexit \"$STATUS\"\n---\nf97a219 Build block-12: FEATURE-RatesLatest.md, FEATURE-LoadVisibility.md [built]\n7d71fb8 Build block-11: FEATURE-Stats.md, FEATURE-Currencies.md, FEATURE-RatesByDate.md, FEATURE-CommandHelp.md [built]\nb06db84 Build block-10: FEATURE-ServeHealth.md [built]","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01H94WWiLg6tozbDyqaudZCj","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01PrweG1XjTAj2LE8CGneBfV","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Currency codes the store can quote: every code with at least one stored rate, ascending.\n\nThe base currency is not a stored code and is never listed. The list comes from\n`db.rates.list_currencies`, which returns one row per stored rate, so duplicates are removed here.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\nfrom fxrates_app.rates import BASE\n\n\ndef currencies() -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Return the distinct stored currency codes, ascending, without the base currency.\"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        rows = db.rates.list_currencies()\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return sorted({row.currency for row in rows} - {BASE})\n\"\"\"Database location: one place decides which store the application opens.\n\nResolution order: DATABASE_URL, then DATABASE_PATH, then data/app.db. The environment is read at\ncall time. Application code opens the store only through `persistence.open_database`.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\n\nfrom persistence import Database, open_database\n\nDEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH = \"data/app.db\"\nSQLITE_PREFIX = \"sqlite://\"\n\n\ndef database_path() -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the database location from the environment, falling back to data/app.db.\"\"\"\n    url = os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_URL\", \"\")\n    if url.startswith(SQLITE_PREFIX):\n        url = url[len(SQLITE_PREFIX):]\n    if url:\n        return url\n    path = os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_PATH\", \"\")\n    if path:\n        return path\n    return DEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH\n\n\ndef open_store() -> Database:\n    \"\"\"Open the store named by `database_path()` through the persistence library.\"\"\"\n    return open_database(database_path())\n---\n\"\"\"Shared pytest fixtures for the FxRates suite.\n\nTests never open a network connection. Any attempt to connect a socket fails the test, so an\naccidental download cannot slip through a suite that is meant to run offline.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport socket\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app_server import testing as app_testing\nfrom cli import testing as cli_testing\n\n\nclass NetworkAccessError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when a test attempts to open a network connection.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _refuse_connection(*_args: object, **_kwargs: object) -> None:\n    raise NetworkAccessError(\"tests must not open network connections\")\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef _block_network(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Iterator[None]:\n    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, \"connect\", _refuse_connection)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, \"create_connection\", _refuse_connection)\n    yield\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef project_root() -> Path:\n    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef cli_runner():\n    return cli_testing.cli_runner\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef web_client():\n    return app_testing.web_client()\n\"\"\"GET /rates/{date} and fxrates_app.rates.effective_date.\n\nEach test shares one acceptance transaction with the web client and rolls back at the end. Tests\nthat depend on which publications exist start from an emptied store inside that transaction.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom fxrates_app.rates import effective_date\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef rolled_back_transaction() -> Iterator[None]:\n    \"\"\"Share one connection between the route and the test, then roll everything back.\"\"\"\n    persistence_db.begin_acceptance_transaction()\n    try:\n        yield\n    finally:\n        persistence_db.end_acceptance_transaction()\n\n\ndef empty_store(db) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Remove every stored rate inside the acceptance transaction.\"\"\"\n    db.rates.delete_from_date(from_date=\"0000-01-01\")\n\n\ndef test_exact_publication_date_returns_its_rates_as_stored_text(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"1900-10-01\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"1.50\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZB\", rate=\"2.250\")\n\n        response = web_client.get(f\"/rates/{d}\")\n\n        assert response.status_code == 200\n        body = response.json()\n        assert body == {\n            \"date\": d,\n            \"requested\": d,\n            \"base\": \"EUR\",\n            \"rates\": {\"ZZA\": \"1.50\", \"ZZB\": \"2.250\"},\n        }\n        stored = {r.currency: r.rate for r in db.rates.list_for_date(date=d)}\n        assert body[\"rates\"] == stored\n\n\ndef test_date_between_publications_resolves_to_the_earlier_one(web_client) -> None:\n    early = \"1900-10-01\"\n    late = \"1900-10-05\"\n    between = \"1900-10-03\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=early, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"1.50\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=late, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"1.6\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(f\"/rates/{between}\").json()\n\n    assert body[\"date\"] == early\n    assert body[\"requested\"] == between\n    assert body[\"rates\"] == {\"ZZA\": \"1.50\"}\n\n\ndef test_date_after_a_later_publication_resolves_to_it(web_client) -> None:\n    early = \"1900-10-01\"\n    late = \"1900-10-05\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=early, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"1\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=late, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"2\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\"/rates/1900-10-09\").json()\n\n    assert body[\"date\"] == late\n    assert body[\"requested\"] == \"1900-10-09\"\n    assert body[\"rates\"] == {\"ZZA\": \"2\"}\n\n\ndef test_base_currency_never_appears_in_the_rates(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"1900-10-06\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"EUR\", rate=\"1\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"2\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(f\"/rates/{d}\").json()\n\n    assert \"EUR\" not in body[\"rates\"]\n    assert body[\"rates\"] == {\"ZZA\": \"2\"}\n\n\ndef test_date_before_every_publication_is_not_found(web_client) -> None:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=\"1900-10-05\", currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"1\")\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/rates/1900-10-01\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_date_on_an_empty_store_is_not_found(web_client) -> None:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/rates/1900-10-01\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 404\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"path\",\n    [\n        \"/rates/2025-13-01\",\n        \"/rates/2025-02-30\",\n        \"/rates/2025-02-29\",\n        \"/rates/not-a-date\",\n        \"/rates/2025-01-31-x\",\n        \"/rates/2025-1-1\",\n        \"/rates/20251031\",\n        \"/rates/2025-01-31T00:00:00\",\n    ],\n)\ndef test_malformed_or_impossible_date_is_unprocessable(web_client, path: str) -> None:\n    response = web_client.get(path)\n\n    assert response.status_code == 422\n\n\ndef test_leap_day_is_accepted_when_it_is_a_real_date(web_client) -> None:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=\"2024-02-29\", currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"1\")\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/rates/2024-02-29\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.json()[\"date\"] == \"2024-02-29\"\n\n\ndef test_effective_date_is_the_latest_publication_on_or_before(web_client) -> None:\n    early = \"1900-10-01\"\n    late = \"1900-10-05\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=early, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"1\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=late, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"2\")\n\n        assert effective_date(\"1900-10-03\") == early\n        assert effective_date(late) == late\n        assert effective_date(\"1899-12-31\") is None\n\n\ndef test_effective_date_is_none_on_an_empty_store() -> None:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n\n        assert effective_date(\"2030-01-01\") is None\n\n\ndef test_rates_route_matches_effective_date_function(web_client) -> None:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=\"1900-10-02\", currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"7\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\"/rates/1900-10-04\").json()\n\n        assert body[\"date\"] == {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgT5AmNPaLsysc9NugK6Q","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_014TPaRfHSEcTyr1NFeJgYqP","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/fxrates_app/convert.py","content":"\"\"\"Conversion between two currencies on a calendar day, in exact decimal arithmetic.\n\nThe base currency EUR has the implicit rate 1; any other rate is the stored ECB text read as a\nDecimal. The pair rate is rate(to) / rate(from), rounded half to even to six decimals. The result is\namount * rate(to) / rate(from), computed exactly from the stored rates and then rounded half to even\nto two decimals, so it never depends on the rounded pair rate. No floating point is used.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Decimal\n\nfrom fxrates_app import rates as rate_service\n\nRATE_QUANTUM = Decimal(\"0.000001\")\nRESULT_QUANTUM = Decimal(\"0.01\")\n\n\nclass UnknownCurrency(LookupError):\n    \"\"\"A currency other than the base has no stored rate on the effective publication.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass UnusableRate(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A stored rate is zero, so it cannot be used as a divisor.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _rate_of(code: str, rates: dict[str, str]) -> Decimal:\n    \"\"\"Return the Decimal rate of `code` against the base; the base itself is 1.\"\"\"\n    if code == rate_service.BASE:\n        return Decimal(1)\n    if code not in rates:\n        raise UnknownCurrency(code)\n    value = Decimal(rates[code])\n    if value == 0:\n        raise UnusableRate(code)\n    return value\n\n\ndef convert(source: str, target: str, amount: str, requested: str | None = None) -> dict[str, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"Convert `amount` of `source` into `target` using the effective publication.\n\n    `requested` is a calendar date; None selects the latest publication. Returns None when no\n    publication exists on or before the requested date.\n    \"\"\"\n    found = rate_service.latest_rates() if requested is None else rate_service.rates_on(requested)\n    if found is None:\n        return None\n    effective, rates = found\n    rate_from = _rate_of(source, rates)\n    rate_to = _rate_of(target, rates)\n    rate = (rate_to / rate_from).quantize(RATE_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    result = (Decimal(amount) * rate_to / rate_from).quantize(RESULT_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    return {\n        \"date\": effective,\n        \"from\": source,\n        \"to\": target,\n        \"amount\": amount,\n        \"rate\": f\"{rate:.6f}\",\n        \"result\": f\"{result:.2f}\",\n    }\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2814,"cache_read_input_tokens":35901,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2814},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"02287bb7-5dee-4304-8fa2-e6c3b7822ad6","uuid":"6f34cd22-50e4-4e5b-8134-3155bca34cb0","timestamp":"2026-10-27T16:40:38.172Z","request_id":"req_011CgT5Am4o3hMj8dfXvSvPN","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_014TPaRfHSEcTyr1NFeJgYqP":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/fxrates_app/convert.py","content":"\"\"\"Conversion between two currencies on a calendar day, in exact decimal arithmetic.\n\nThe base currency EUR has the implicit rate 1; any other rate is the stored ECB text read as a\nDecimal. The pair rate is rate(to) / rate(from), rounded half to even to six decimals. The result is\namount * rate(to) / rate(from), computed exactly from the stored rates and then rounded half to even\nto two decimals, so it never depends on the rounded pair rate. No floating point is used.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Decimal\n\nfrom fxrates_app import rates as rate_service\n\nRATE_QUANTUM = Decimal(\"0.000001\")\nRESULT_QUANTUM = Decimal(\"0.01\")\n\n\nclass UnknownCurrency(LookupError):\n    \"\"\"A currency other than the base has no stored rate on the effective publication.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass UnusableRate(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A stored rate is zero, so it cannot be used as a divisor.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _rate_of(code: str, rates: dict[str, str]) -> Decimal:\n    \"\"\"Return the Decimal rate of `code` against the base; the base itself is 1.\"\"\"\n    if code == rate_service.BASE:\n        return Decimal(1)\n    if code not in rates:\n        raise UnknownCurrency(code)\n    value = Decimal(rates[code])\n    if value == 0:\n        raise UnusableRate(code)\n    return value\n\n\ndef convert(source: str, target: str, amount: str, requested: str | None = None) -> dict[str, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"Convert `amount` of `source` into `target` using the effective publication.\n\n    `requested` is a calendar date; None selects the latest publication. Returns None when no\n    publication exists on or before the requested date.\n    \"\"\"\n    found = rate_service.latest_rates() if requested is None else rate_service.rates_on(requested)\n    if found is None:\n        return None\n    effective, rates = found\n    rate_from = _rate_of(source, rates)\n    rate_to = _rate_of(target, rates)\n    rate = (rate_to / rate_from).quantize(RATE_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    result = (Decimal(amount) * rate_to / rate_from).quantize(RESULT_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    return {\n        \"date\": effective,\n        \"from\": source,\n        \"to\": target,\n        \"amount\": amount,\n        \"rate\": f\"{rate:.6f}\",\n        \"result\": f\"{result:.2f}\",\n    }\n"}}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgT5DQAmASJz1vorrg4Nk","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01B6w2rmYTgYNhXxJ7eT1sLc","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/fxrates_app/history.py","content":"\"\"\"A currency's stored rates over a period, ascending by date, returned as the stored text.\n\nPoints come from `db.rates.list_currency_history` in one call per request, so a load completed\nbefore the request is visible to it. Both bounds are optional and inclusive; a start later than the\nend matches nothing. Rates are never converted to a number.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\n\ndef history_points(code: str, start: str | None = None, end: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return {\"date\", \"rate\"} points for `code` from `start` through `end`, ascending by date.\"\"\"\n    arguments: dict[str, str] = {\"currency\": code}\n    if start is not None:\n        arguments[\"start_date\"] = start\n    if end is not None:\n        arguments[\"end_date\"] = end\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        rows = db.rates.list_currency_history(**arguments)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return [{\"date\": row.date, \"rate\": row.rate} for row in rows]\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":8373,"cache_read_input_tokens":38715,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":8373},"output_tokens":16,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"02287bb7-5dee-4304-8fa2-e6c3b7822ad6","uuid":"c91ee3f0-253a-48d8-80e4-b866eefd9d8d","timestamp":"2026-10-27T16:40:41.117Z","request_id":"req_011CgT5DPrfqNrgDSW3L1ypQ","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01B6w2rmYTgYNhXxJ7eT1sLc":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/fxrates_app/history.py","content":"\"\"\"A currency's stored rates over a period, ascending by date, returned as the stored text.\n\nPoints come from `db.rates.list_currency_history` in one call per request, so a load completed\nbefore the request is visible to it. Both bounds are optional and inclusive; a start later than the\nend matches nothing. Rates are never converted to a number.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\n\ndef history_points(code: str, start: str | None = None, end: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return {\"date\", \"rate\"} points for `code` from `start` through `end`, ascending by date.\"\"\"\n    arguments: dict[str, str] = {\"currency\": code}\n    if start is not None:\n        arguments[\"start_date\"] = start\n    if end is not None:\n        arguments[\"end_date\"] = end\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        rows = db.rates.list_currency_history(**arguments)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return [{\"date\": row.date, \"rate\": row.rate} for row in rows]\n"}}}

import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom fxrates_app import convert as convert_service\nfrom persistence import and the test, then roll everything back.\"\"\"\n    persistence_db.begin_acceptance_transaction()\n    try:\n        yield\n    finally:\n        persistence_db.end_acceptance_transaction()\n\n\ndef empty_store(db) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Remove every stored rate inside the acceptance transaction.\"\"\"\n    db.rates.delete_from_date(from_date=\"0000-01-01\")\n\n\ndef test_two_currencies_convert_with_six_and_two_decimals(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"2999-01-01\"\n    rate_from = \"1.0298\"\n    rate_to = \"0.84453\"\n    amount = \"100\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=rate_from)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZB\", rate=rate_to)\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"ZZA\", \"to\": \"ZZB\", \"amount\": amount, \"date\": d})\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    expected_rate = (Decimal(rate_to) / Decimal(rate_from)).quantize(Decimal(\"0.000001\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    expected_result = (Decimal(amount) * Decimal(rate_to) / Decimal(rate_from)).quantize(\n        Decimal(\"0.01\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN\n    )\n    assert response.json() == {\n        \"date\": d,\n        \"from\": \"ZZA\",\n        \"to\": \"ZZB\",\n        \"amount\": amount,\n        \"rate\": f\"{expected_rate:.6f}\",\n        \"result\": f\"{expected_result:.2f}\",\n    }\n\n\ndef test_amount_is_echoed_as_given(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"2999-01-02\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"2\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"EUR\", \"to\": \"ZZA\", \"amount\": \"007.50\", \"date\": d}).json()\n\n    assert body[\"amount\"] == \"007.50\"\n    assert body[\"result\"] == \"15.00\"\n\n\ndef test_eur_to_stored_currency_uses_rate_one_for_eur(web_client) -> rate=\"161.77\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\n            \"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"EUR\", \"to\": \"ZZA\", \"amount\": \"250.25\", \"date\": requested}\n        ).json()\n\n    assert Tests\nthat depend on which publications exist start from an emptied store inside that transaction, and\nexpected values are derived with Decimal from the seeded rates.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom fxrates_app import convert as convert_service\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef rolled_back_transaction() -> Iterator[None]:\n    \"\"\"Share one connection between the route and the test, then roll everything back.\"\"\"\n    persistence_db.begin_acceptance_transaction()\n    try:\n        yield\n    finally:\n        persistence_db.end_acceptance_transaction()\n\n\ndef empty_store(db) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Remove every stored rate inside the acceptance transaction.\"\"\"\n    db.rates.delete_from_date(from_date=\"0000-01-01\")\n\n\ndef test_two_currencies_convert_with_six_and_two_decimals(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"2999-01-01\"\n    rate_from = \"1.0298\"\n    rate_to = \"0.84453\"\n    amount = \"100\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=rate_from)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZB\", rate=rate_to)\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"ZZA\", \"to\": \"ZZB\", \"amount\": amount, \"date\": d})\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    expected_rate = (Decimal(rate_to) / Decimal(rate_from)).quantize(Decimal(\"0.000001\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    expected_result = (Decimal(amount) * Decimal(rate_to) / Decimal(rate_from)).quantize(\n        Decimal(\"0.01\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN\n    )\n    assert response.json() == {\n        \"date\": d,\n        \"from\": \"ZZA\",\n        \"to\": \"ZZB\",\n        \"amount\": amount,\n        \"rate\": f\"{expected_rate:.6f}\",\n        \"result\": f\"{expected_result:.2f}\",\n    }\n\n\ndef test_amount_is_echoed_as_given(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"2999-01-02\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"2\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"EUR\", \"to\": \"ZZA\", \"amount\": \"007.50\", \"date\": d}).json()\n\n    assert body[\"amount\"] == \"007.50\"\n    assert body[\"result\"] == \"15.00\"\n\n\ndef test_eur_to_stored_currency_uses_rate_one_for_eur(web_client) -> None:\n    published = \"2999-02-01\"\n    requested = \"2999-02-03\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=published, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"161.77\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\n            \"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"EUR\", \"to\": \"ZZA\", \"amount\": \"250.25\", \"date\": requested}\n        ).json()\n\n    assert body[\"date\"] == published\n    assert body[\"rate\"] == \"161.770000\"\n    assert body[\"result\"] == \"40472.94\"\n\n\ndef test_stored_currency_to_eur_divides_by_the_stored_rate(web_client) -> None:\n    published = \"2999-02-01\"\n    requested = \"2999-02-03\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=published, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"161.77\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\n            \"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"ZZA\", \"to\": \"EUR\", \"amount\": \"1000\", \"date\": requested}\n        ).json()\n\n    assert body[\"date\"] == published\n    assert body[\"rate\"] == f\"{(Decimal(1) / Decimal('161.77')).quantize(Decimal('0.000001'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN):.6f}\"\n    assert body[\"result\"] == f\"{(Decimal('1000') / Decimal('161.77')).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN):.2f}\"\n\n\ndef test_without_date_the_latest_publication_is_used(web_client) -> None:\n    older = \"2999-03-01\"\n    newest = \"2999-03-09\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=older, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"2\")\n import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom fxrates_app import convert as convert_service\nfrom persistence import and the test, then roll everything back.\"\"\"\n    persistence_db.begin_acceptance_transaction()\n    try:\n        yield\n    finally:\n        persistence_db.end_acceptance_transaction()\n\n\ndef empty_store(db) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Remove every stored rate inside the acceptance transaction.\"\"\"\n    db.rates.delete_from_date(from_date=\"0000-01-01\")\n\n\ndef test_two_currencies_convert_with_six_and_two_decimals(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"2999-01-01\"\n    rate_from = \"1.0298\"\n    rate_to = \"0.84453\"\n    amount = \"100\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=rate_from)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZB\", rate=rate_to)\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"ZZA\", \"to\": \"ZZB\", \"amount\": amount, \"date\": d})\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    expected_rate = (Decimal(rate_to) / Decimal(rate_from)).quantize(Decimal(\"0.000001\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    expected_result = (Decimal(amount) * Decimal(rate_to) / Decimal(rate_from)).quantize(\n        Decimal(\"0.01\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN\n    )\n    assert response.json() == {\n        \"date\": d,\n        \"from\": \"ZZA\",\n        \"to\": \"ZZB\",\n        \"amount\": amount,\n        \"rate\": \"007.50\", \"date\": d}).json()\n\n    assert body[\"amount\"] == \"007.50\"\n    assert body[\"result\"] == \"15.00\"\n\n\ndef test_eur_to_stored_currency_uses_rate_one_for_eur(web_client) -> {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgT5FfL8yaPweQL9k18Xb","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_014gj6Qtca8zZ74KhziVtKzc","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/tests/test_history_points.py","content":"\"\"\"GET /history/{code} and fxrates_app.history: a currency's stored points between optional bounds.\n\nEach test shares one acceptance transaction with the web client and rolls back at the end. Rates\nare compared as the stored text; no test converts them to a number.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom fxrates_app import history as history_service\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef rolled_back_transaction() -> Iterator[None]:\n    \"\"\"Share one connection between the route and the test, then roll everything back.\"\"\"\n    persistence_db.begin_acceptance_transaction()\n    try:\n        yield\n    finally:\n        persistence_db.end_acceptance_transaction()\n\n\ndef empty_store(db) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Remove every stored rate inside the acceptance transaction.\"\"\"\n    db.rates.delete_from_date(from_date=\"0000-01-01\")\n\n\ndef test_points_between_inclusive_bounds_are_ascending(web_client) -> None:\n    code = \"ZZH\"\n    rates = {\"1900-08-03\": \"1.50\", \"1900-08-01\": \"1.0316\", \"1900-08-02\": \"2\", \"1900-08-04\": \"0.943\"}\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        for d, r in rates.items():\n            db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=code, rate=r)\n\n        body = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\", params={\"start\": \"1900-08-02\", \"end\": \"1900-08-03\"}).json()\n\n    assert body[\"points\"] == [{\"date\": \"1900-08-02\", \"rate\": \"2\"}, {\"date\": \"1900-08-03\", \"rate\": \"1.50\"}]\n    assert body[\"count\"] == 2\n\n\ndef test_response_names_the_currency_and_base(web_client) -> None:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=\"1900-08-05\", currency=\"ZZH\", rate=\"1\")\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/history/ZZH\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    body = response.json()\n    assert body[\"currency\"] == \"ZZH\"\n    assert body[\"base\"] == \"EUR\"\n\n\ndef test_each_bound_is_optional_on_its_own(web_client) -> None:\n    code = \"ZZH\"\n    rates = {\"1900-09-04\": \"0.943\", \"1900-09-02\": \"1.50\", \"1900-09-03\": \"1.0316\", \"1900-09-01\": \"7\"}\n    cut = \"1900-09-03\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        for d, r in rates.items():\n            db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=code, rate=r)\n\n        everything = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\").json()\n        from_cut = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\", params={\"start\": cut}).json()\n        to_cut = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\", params={\"end\": cut}).json()\n\n    assert everything[\"points\"] == [{\"date\": d, \"rate\": rates[d]} for d in sorted(rates)]\n    assert from_cut[\"points\"] == [{\"date\": d, \"rate\": rates[d]} for d in sorted(rates) if d >= cut]\n    assert to_cut[\"points\"] == [{\"date\": d, \"rate\": rates[d]} for d in sorted(rates) if d <= cut]\n\n\ndef test_stored_rate_text_is_returned_exactly(web_client) -> None:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=\"1900-09-10\", currency=\"ZZH\", rate=\"0.943\")\n\n        points = web_client.get(\"/history/ZZH\").json()[\"points\"]\n\n    assert points == [{\"date\": \"1900-09-10\", \"rate\": \"0.943\"}]\n\n\ndef test_start_after_end_is_ok_with_no_points(web_client) -> None:\n    code = \"ZZH\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        for d in [\"1900-10-01\", \"1900-10-02\", \"1900-10-03\"]:\n            db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=code, rate=\"3\")\n\n        response = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\", params={\"start\": \"1900-10-03\", \"end\": \"1900-10-01\"})\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    body = response.json()\n    assert body[\"points\"] == []\n    assert body[\"count\"] == 0\n\n\ndef test_replaced_rate_is_what_the_next_request_returns(web_client) -> None:\n    code = \"ZZH\"\n    d = \"1900-11-01\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=code, rate=\"1.25\")\n        assert web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\").json()[\"points\"] == [{\"date\": d, \"rate\": \"1.25\"}]\n\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=code, rate=\"1.75\")\n        body = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\").json()\n\n    assert body[\"points\"] == [{\"date\": d, \"rate\": \"1.75\"}]\n    assert body[\"count\"] == 1\n\n\ndef test_points_are_only_those_of_the_requested_currency(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"1900-11-02\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZH\", rate=\"1\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZJ\", rate=\"2\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\"/history/ZZH\").json()\n\n    assert body[\"points\"] == [{\"date\": d, \"rate\": \"1\"}]\n\n\ndef test_unknown_currency_has_no_points_but_is_ok(web_client) -> None:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/history/ZZNONE\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.json()[\"points\"] == []\n    assert response.json()[\"count\"] == 0\n\n\ndef test_bounds_equal_to_a_publication_date_include_it(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"1900-11-03\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZH\", rate=\"4\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\"/history/ZZH\", params={\"start\": d, \"end\": d}).json()\n\n    assert body[\"points\"] == [{\"date\": d, \"rate\": \"4\"}]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"params\",\n    [\n        {\"start\": \"2025-02-30\"},\n        {\"end\": \"2025-13-01\"},\n        {\"start\": \"not-a-date\"},\n        {\"end\": \"20251031\"},\n    ],\n)\ndef test_malformed_or_impossible_bound_is_unprocessable(web_client, params: dict[str, str]) -> None:\n    response = web_client.get(\"/history/ZZH\", params=params)\n\n    assert response.status_code == 422\n\n\ndef test_service_matches_the_route(web_client) -> None:\n    code = \"ZZH\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n
